purpose: Enumerate exact source-visible symbolic tokens in the frozen L bodies after ordinary 0.20 incidence repair. No conventional mathematical meaning is assigned by this frontier; every token requires source-local adjudication before semantic promotion.
guards: Token kinds are lexical/source-visible only; PLUS does not assert addition, STAR does not assert Hodge duality, TENSOR does not assert tensor-product semantics, and so on.
Hyphen/minus and slash are not scanned generically because prose/names use them ambiguously; numeric fractions are recorded explicitly.

Compact named operators such as dA, Dphi, det(...), tilde(...), bar(...), and source juxtaposition require a separate source-local review because their operator boundaries are not safely determined by symbol lexing alone.
A token inside an identifier or role label may be adjudicated NON_OPERATOR_SOURCE_TOKEN; no token is promoted automatically.
This frontier neither closes G1 nor authorizes G2.

items.body: L01 defines curvature by F=dA+1/2[A,A] and uses Lie brackets both as algebraic interaction structure and, in selected exceptional embeddings, as the source of subgroup-representation actions.

L01 embeds su(3) together with defining 3 and dual bar3 weight carriers into g2=g2 decomposition su(3)+3+bar3, treating quark/anti-quark generators as Lie-algebra root vectors rather than only external representation vectors.
L01 represents gravitational so(3,1)=Cl^2(3,1) using explicit chiral Clifford matrices, decomposes the spin connection into left/right chiral blocks, and represents the frame in Cl^1(3,1).
L01 builds explicit Cl(7,1) generators and the graviweak connection H1=1/2 omega+1/4 e phi+w_ew, acting chirally on an 8-dimensional positive-chiral spinor carrier.
L01 introduces a canonical order-three D4 triality rotation cycling 8_S+, 8_S-, and 8_V and tentatively uses the three triality-related 8-dimensional roles for the three fermion generations.
L01 combines F4 and G2+U(1) quantum-number structures so that 222 gravitational/Standard-Model field weights match 222 of the 240 E8 roots before the remaining roots are assigned to new fields.

Within F1, L01 decomposes curvature into gravitational, mixed graviweak, and electroweak parts; the gravitational term combines Riemann curvature with an e e phi^2 term, while the mixed term is torsion times phi minus e Dphi.
L02 treats the fundamental bosonic variable as a connection H over a four-dimensional base, valued in g=spin(1+N,3), with spacetime spin(1,3), Yang-Mills spin(N), and off-diagonal complement roles.

L02 begins from a fully g-invariant polynomial extended-Plebanski action S(H,B,Phi) with one parameter g, curvature F=dH+1/2[H,H], an auxiliary g-valued 2-form B, and a symmetric operator Phi acting on bivectors and 2-forms.

L02 makes a Phi ansatz as a linear combination of identity, Hodge dual, Lie-algebra dual, and their composition; one solution class reduces to Phi=* and B=3/4 *F, leaving a Yang-Mills-form equation D*F=0.

After symmetry breaking L02 decomposes H=1/2 omega+1/4 E+A into spin connection, off-diagonal frame-Higgs, and Yang-Mills connection, and makes the simple-bivector ansatz E=e' phi with frame e' and Higgs zero-form phi.
L02 explicitly distinguishes the frame e used to build the Hodge star from the frame e' appearing in the connection and only later restricts to the solution subset e'=e.
The broken curvature decomposes into gravitational R-1/8 Sigma' phi^2, mixed T phi-e'Dphi, and Yang-Mills F_A sectors, with torsion and Higgs covariant derivative separately defined.

The symmetry-broken field equations separate into spacetime, off-diagonal, and Yang-Mills roles and admit a broad solution space; matching e'=e and setting torsion to zero (without fermionic sources) are consistent restrictions, not consequences of symmetry breaking.
With Phi=* the action becomes a Yang-Mills-form curvature-squared action; substituting the broken connection yields gravitational, torsion/Higgs, and Yang-Mills terms before further restriction.

After e'=e and vanishing torsion, the low-energy action contains Einstein-Hilbert, cosmological/Higgs potential, a Stephenson-Kilmister-Yang curvature-squared modification, Higgs kinetic, and Yang-Mills terms.
Fermions couple through the covariant Dirac derivative (d+H)psi; after breaking this yields spin, frame-Higgs, and Yang-Mills interactions, and the source expects fermions to source torsion.

The 18 gravity+Standard-Model generators in the 64-real realization retain real Lie-algebra structure constants and act on the 64-real fermion column exactly as their 32-complex counterparts act on the original generation.

The 18 conventional gravity+Standard-Model 64-real generators are numerically identical, in the chosen representation, to specified positive-chiral spin(11,3) bivector combinations, making the fermion 64-real carrier componentwise identical to a positive-chiral Majorana-Weyl spinor.

The same spin(11,3) Clifford presentation contains the Pati-Salam chain su(4)+su(2)_L+su(2)_R subset spin(10) subset spin(11,3), with the Standard Model generators as a subset and forty complementary spin(11,3) generators available for frame-Higgs roles.

L03 defines frame, spin connection, torsion, spin(10) Higgs covariant derivative, and combines spin connection, frame-Higgs, and gauge field into the spin(11,3) bosonic connection H=1/2 omega+1/4 e phi+A.

The curvature of the unified spin(11,3) bosonic connection decomposes into R-1/8 ee phi^2, mixed T phi-eDphi, and spin(10) gauge curvature sectors; the frame-Higgs vev is used to summarize symmetry breaking to gravity+SM and mass generation.

L03's exact algebraic embedding therefore includes both the gravity+SM Lie algebra and its correct action on one fermion generation; this exact embedding claim is distinct from any claim that every E8 generator has a physically correct particle interpretation.

L03 forms a superconnection A=H+psi from bosonic connection 1-forms and Grassmann-valued fermionic fields in the same algebra; its curvature contains F, Dpsi, and a quadratic psi psi term, with Dpsi matching the source's covariant Dirac derivative for the selected fermion subspace.

L04 treats a Dirac spinor as an irreducible representation of Pin(1,3), not merely Spin+(1,3), and distinguishes the Pin extension by parity P and unitary time conjugation T_U from the connected Lorentz-spin subgroup.

L04 distinguishes Pin(1,3) from Pin(3,1) by the squares of P, T, and PT, then deliberately chooses the phase-modified representative U_P=i gamma_0 so spinors acquire P^2=-1 while calculations retain Spin+(1,3)≈SL(2,C).
L04 defines charge conjugation by the antiunitary operator U_C=i gamma_2 K and distinguishes quantized time reversal U_T^Q=gamma_13 from the antiunitary unquantized representative U_T=gamma_13 K.

L04 derives antiunitary time conjugation on QFT operators as momentum reflection plus spin exchange, preserving helicity and charge; T^2=-1 is used to classify the fermion representation space as quaternionic.
L04 first constructs a mathematically valid but non-unique triality extension using t'=-1/2(1+e1+e2+e3), yielding 2T×Z2 of order 48 because t' commutes with C.
Rather than guessing new generators, L04 reconstructs the C/P/T operations after reorganizing Dirac degrees of freedom into left/right chiral biquaternionic carriers C⊗H.

The biquaternionic representation uses the Pauli realization e0~sigma0, e_pi~-i sigma_pi and an exact relation between left/right chiral biquaternions and the original Dirac/charge-conjugate components.
L04's biquaternionic invariant satisfies tilde(psi_HL) psi_HL=det(psi_QL), while the Dirac scalar bar(Psi)Psi is twice the real part of that invariant.
In the final biquaternionic presentation the source uses C~i e1, P~-K e3, T~-K e2, and CPT~-i, with quaternionic multiplication acting from the right.
Adding t~-1/2(1+e1+e2+e3) or ad_t gives a triality generator that does not commute with C but does commute with CPT; from C/P/T/t the source also constructs a complex/creation conjugation K.
The final CPTt group has order 96 and is the central product 2T∘D4, with Q8, 2T, and D4 normal subgroups sharing center {±1}; L04 v2 records GAP ID [96,202].

L04 gives a projective 24-cell representation with coordinates (omega_t,omega_S,h,q), omega_t=4 omega_S h q, first-generation C/P/T sign matrices, and a triality matrix relating second/third-generation weights.
Compositions of generalized reflections produce ordinary rotations and generalized triality automorphisms t^(uw); the canonical u=w=1 case cycles (v,psi,chi)->(psi,chi,v).

The magic-square Lie algebra decomposition is Tri(D')+Tri(D)+D'_v⊗D_v+D'_m⊗D_m+D'_p⊗D_p with brackets inherited from the constituent triality structures; each member has a canonical triality automorphism built from the constituent automorphisms.
An order-three triality automorphism decomposes each relevant Lie algebra into g_-1+g_0+g_+1 with bracket grading modulo three, conjugate ±1 eigenspaces, and a real invariant subalgebra g_0.
L05 constructs e6 from C⊗O triality data, with explicit brackets/real-form dependence, canonical triality, so(10)+u(1)+16+16 decomposition, and Standard-Model/GUT charge combinations.

L05 constructs e7 from H⊗O triality data and distinguishes two model-building readings: a real one-generation model with both chiralities or a complex/triality three-generation interpretation that cannot simultaneously house all chiral/antiparticle partners in the same real form.

L05 constructs e8 from O⊗O triality data with explicit bracket classes, real-form signatures, and canonical triality automorphisms; particle labels on roots are source model assignments layered over the algebra.

The MacDowell-Mansouri presentation combines spin connection and frame-Higgs into a Spin(1,4) connection H=1/2 omega+E, with E=e phi_S and fixed spacelike Higgs vev; its curvature splits into R+EE and torsion pieces.

For large G with H⊂G0⊂G, L06 defines a generalized Cartan connection C=1/2 omega+E+A with values in Lie(H), Lie(G0/H), and Lie(G/G0), respectively, and treats it as pullback of a generalized Ehresmann-Cartan connection over the deforming group.

The generalized Cartan curvature decomposes exactly as (1/2 R+EE)+DE+F_A; reduction of a full-group integral to spacetime requires the integrand to be independent of the rigid G/G0 and H coordinates and introduces their group volumes as factors.

The preferred L06 superconnection G=C+Psi consists of bosonic spacetime 1-forms and anticommuting non-spacetime/vertical 1-forms orthogonal to embedded spacetime, valued in complementary Lie-algebra sectors; the exact vertical fermion directions are admitted as not fully specified.

L06 supplies a polynomial modified-BF alternative with auxiliary B and Phi whose field equations admit Phi equal to the deforming-group Hodge operator and B=*F, reproducing the generalized Yang-Mills equations.

L06 states that the target large algebra must contain spin(1,3)+frame⊗Higgs+su(2)_L+u(1)_Y+su(3) acting on three fermion generations, and reviews the one-generation spin(11,3) embedding as an algebraic input.

L06 instead uses the E8(-24)=spin(4,4)+spin(8)+three 64-generator triality blocks decomposition and presumes each fermion generation is accessible only from its corresponding triality-related spacetime region; under this regional assumption it claims three chiral generations without mirror fermions.

The weak su(2)_L does not fit wholly inside spin(4,4)+spin(8) with the other target generators; L06 therefore places weak degrees across triality blocks and infers Majorana-neutrino and CKM/PMNS-mixing implications from that model arrangement.
